newsitem.title: USA: Option Care selected as service provider.
newsitem.headline: Option Care selected as service provider.

text.p: Option Care Inc said Tuesday it was selected as a nationwide provider of home healthcare services for Private Healthcare Systems.

Under the agreement, effective May 1, Option Care will provide comprehensive homecare services, including nursing, infusion therapy, home medical equipment and respiratory therapy services. This agreement makes Option Care services available to over five million Private Healthcare clients across the United States.
The value of the agreement was not given.
Option Care is a full service home healthcare provider with a national network of 184 company-owned and franchised locations.
